purpose: Boundary-coordinate displacement validation using fixed multi-threshold isocontours
measurement: For each of nine circular features, use symmetric left/right crossings at 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, and 70% local contrast on five horizontal chords; take the median threshold displacement per feature and the median across features.
fairness: Raw, NAFNet, EDSR, and MOSR share the same Raw-defined position windows, pre-locked 30 steps, thresholds, validity rules, and physical pixel scales.
position_reference: The PI platform-reported commanded step stored for each capture group is treated as the displacement reference; no method-specific calibration is applied.
